title: Perfect projection comparison for fixed data
statement: For fixed data from the parent node, the projection comparison is invertible for every perfect complex.

proof.text: Use perfect_tensor_hom_duality on Y to obtain both exact pairings K,D and D,K. Map the first pairing by the given strong monoidal pullback.

Conjugate commTensorLeft at the dual under the composite tensor-left and pullback adjunctions. Mathlib conjugation preserves isomorphisms; monoidal_projection_conjugate identifies its components with the specified canonical projection map. Construct pfK and the projection isomorphism for D and every E as the inverses of these components.

For every quasi-coherent E compose full-subcategory Hom equivalences, pulled tensor duality, adj.symm, projection for D, tensor duality on Y, the right unitor and adj. The new tensor-Hom counit comparison identifies this explicitly written equivalence with postcomposition by the required mate. Its bijectivity and Yoneda imply IsIso.
